cloze.sentence: The discovery of DNA introduced a new scientific ____ that reshaped the whole field of biology.
For decades, the behaviourist ____ dominated the study of learning in psychology.
Researchers argue that the dominant economic ____ has failed to explain recent financial crises.
A shift in the medical ____ now treats prevention as being as important as cure.
The study challenges the prevailing ____ by proposing an entirely different model of memory.
Each research ____ carries its own assumptions about what counts as valid evidence.
The Copernican ____ replaced the belief that the Earth stood at the centre of the universe.
Digital learning represents a genuine ____ change in how universities deliver education.
The author calls for a new ____ in which sustainability guides every policy decision.
Under the classical ____, illness was often explained as an imbalance of bodily fluids.

translate.source: Phát hiện này đã tạo ra một mô hình tư duy hoàn toàn mới trong ngành vật lý.
Nhiều nhà nghiên cứu cho rằng đã đến lúc thay đổi hệ hình cũ.
Mô hình giáo dục truyền thống đang dần bị thay thế bởi một hệ hình mới.
Bài báo đề xuất một mô hình lý thuyết khác để giải thích hiện tượng này.
Sự chuyển đổi mô hình này ảnh hưởng đến toàn bộ cách chúng ta nhìn nhận vấn đề.
This experiment does not fit neatly into the existing scientific paradigm.
The lecturer explained how a paradigm shapes the questions a discipline is willing to ask.
A dominant paradigm can make alternative theories difficult to publish.
The thesis situates itself within a constructivist paradigm of learning.
Once a paradigm collapses, the whole discipline must rebuild its assumptions.

scenario: In a research proposal, describe which theoretical paradigm your study is grounded in. Use a formal academic tone.
During a seminar presentation, explain to classmates how a major discovery caused a paradigm shift. Keep the register academic.
Write a sentence for a literature review noting that a long-held paradigm is now being questioned. Use formal English.
In an essay conclusion, argue that education needs a new paradigm centred on sustainability. Keep it persuasive but academic.
You are writing a textbook definition. Explain what a scientific paradigm is in one clear formal sentence.
In a debate on economics, claim that the current paradigm cannot explain recent events. Use a measured, formal tone.
Write a caption for an academic poster describing the shift from one paradigm to another. Keep it concise and formal.
In a job talk for a research post, state which paradigm guides your methodology. Use professional register.
Write a sentence for a history-of-science essay describing how the Copernican paradigm replaced an older view. Formal tone.
In an abstract, note that your findings challenge the dominant paradigm in the field. Keep it academic and concise.

cloze.sentence: The sample was small; ____, the results point to a clear and consistent trend.
The theory is decades old but remains, ____, highly influential in the field.
The evidence is limited. ____, it is sufficient to justify further investigation.
The two studies used different methods; their conclusions were ____ remarkably similar.
Critics dismissed the paper, which ____ went on to shape the whole discipline.
The reform faced strong opposition; it was ____ adopted the following year.
Funding was cut sharply. The team ____ managed to complete the experiment.
The model has obvious weaknesses. It is, ____, a useful starting point for analysis.
Her argument is controversial; it deserves, ____, careful and serious consideration.
The data are incomplete. ____, some cautious conclusions can reasonably be drawn.

translate.source: Mẫu nghiên cứu khá nhỏ; tuy nhiên, kết quả vẫn đáng tin cậy.
Lý thuyết này đã cũ; dù vậy, nó vẫn rất có ảnh hưởng.
Có nhiều hạn chế; tuy nhiên, nghiên cứu vẫn đóng góp quan trọng.
Chi phí rất cao; dù vậy, dự án vẫn được phê duyệt.
Bằng chứng còn ít; tuy nhiên, chúng ta có thể rút ra vài kết luận thận trọng.
The hypothesis was rejected; nonetheless, the experiment yielded valuable data.
The book is difficult to read; it is, nonetheless, worth the effort.
There were methodological flaws; nonetheless, the pattern is hard to ignore.
The policy was unpopular but was nonetheless carried out in full.
Progress was slow; nonetheless, the goal was eventually achieved.

scenario: In an essay, concede a weakness in your evidence but insist the argument still holds. Use 'nonetheless' in a formal tone.
Write a sentence for a research discussion acknowledging a limitation while defending the conclusion. Academic register.
In a review of a book, admit a flaw yet recommend it anyway. Keep the tone formal and balanced.
During a formal debate, accept an opponent's point but explain why your position stands. Use 'nonetheless'.
In a lab report, note that despite equipment problems the results are still meaningful. Formal scientific tone.
Write a sentence for a policy brief admitting costs are high but the reform is still justified. Formal register.
In a cover letter, acknowledge a gap in your experience while stressing your strengths. Professional tone.
In an academic abstract, concede the sample size is small but claim the findings are significant. Formal.
Write a sentence for a history essay noting an idea was rejected at the time but proved influential. Academic tone.
In a project post-mortem for managers, admit difficulties yet report that the target was met. Formal register.

cloze.sentence: The initial results were inconclusive, and the researchers ____ redesigned the experiment.
Demand for the course rose sharply; the university ____ opened three new sections.
The data revealed a clear bias, and the model was ____ adjusted before publication.
Safety standards had changed, so the guidelines were ____ revised.
The committee found the proposal flawed and ____ recommended further revision.
Costs had risen faster than expected; the budget was ____ increased.
The survey showed low satisfaction, and the service was ____ reformed.
New evidence contradicted the theory, and it was ____ abandoned by most scholars.
The deadline was moved forward, and the team planned its work ____.
Readers' needs differ widely, and the textbook was ____ written at several levels.

translate.source: Kết quả không rõ ràng, và do đó nhóm đã thiết kế lại thí nghiệm.
Nhu cầu tăng cao, theo đó trường mở thêm nhiều lớp học.
Tiêu chuẩn đã thay đổi, do đó hướng dẫn được sửa đổi lại.
Ngân sách bị cắt giảm, và kế hoạch được điều chỉnh theo đó.
Bằng chứng mới xuất hiện, và lý thuyết cũ do đó bị bác bỏ.
The findings were significant, and policy was accordingly reconsidered.
The rules had changed, so applicants were advised to act accordingly.
Costs exceeded the estimate, and the plan was accordingly scaled back.
The audience was mostly beginners, and the lecture was pitched accordingly.
Errors were found in the dataset, and the analysis was accordingly repeated.

scenario: In a methods section, explain that after a pilot failed you changed the design accordingly. Formal academic tone.

The findings were presented at a conference and ____ expanded into a book.
The policy was introduced in one city and ____ adopted across the country.

The students read the article and ____ discussed it in their tutorial.

Loại thuốc này vượt qua thử nghiệm và sau đó được phê duyệt.
Bài viết bị từ chối, nhưng sau đó được đăng trên một tạp chí lớn.
Chính sách được áp dụng ở một thành phố và sau đó lan ra cả nước.
Người tham gia làm khảo sát và sau đó được phỏng vấn.
The mixture was heated and subsequently cooled to room temperature.
The idea was dismissed at first but subsequently gained wide support.

Write a sentence for a history essay dating an undated document, hedging with 'presumably'. Formal register.

Tổ chức này bề ngoài là từ thiện, nhưng thực ra hoạt động vì lợi nhuận.
